term: cause in Hume's asymmetry maxim and in the causal-history premise
resolution: Hume's maxim (STMT-HUME-NO-MUTUAL-CAUSE) is about his relation of cause and effect; STMT-CAUSAL-HISTORY-HAS-NO-LOOPS is about the supplied causal relation of the causal-finitism route, which by STMT-PER-SE-LINKS-IN-FINITE-HISTORY-RELATION must contain the per se efficient-cause links. Result HUME-NO-MUTUAL-CAUSE-FROM-NO-LOOPS is relation-generic: for any one relation, no loops entails Hume's maxim for that relation. It therefore never transfers Hume's attestation from his relation to the case's, and never identifies the two relations.
